Name: DualScreenValley
Author: EveMercury
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Fix up the Android version of Stardew valley for dual screen devices like the Ayn Thor with a few QoL improvements to make the android version feel more like the desktop version using a controller.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Lay out any steps users must follow to install your mod[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Moves most UI elements to the bottom screen for an immersive experience on the upper screen[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds mini-map to the lower screen if NPC Map Locations is installed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Added a dedicated pause button[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Added a pause menu with a custom controller config menu since most dual screen devices have built in controls[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Re-added item stowing option in the games options.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Click right and left stick to toggle single and dual screen modes[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to Claude Code for accelerating the development of this mod considerably.[/color][/size]

[b]My notes on AI usage[/b]
[b]Yes this mod was made with the help of AI. I can understand the frustration some of you have about AI usage and I understand if you choose not to use my mod because of it. I will respect your decision to not use AI generated content if you respect my choice to use AI.[/b]

[b]All features were laid out ahead of time with a clear plan and goal from the beginning, and all features were fully tested by me before releasing this mod. [/b]

Manifest.Name: Dual Screen Valley
Manifest.Description: Moves the HUD, toolbar, menus and map to the second screen on dual-screen Android handhelds (AYN Thor), leaving the top screen for the world.
Manifest.Author: rdennings
